issues.title: Building envelope condition is unknown
issues.oneLineReason: Recent moisture staining on the north elevation has not been assessed.
issues.whyItMatters: Recent moisture staining on the north elevation has not been assessed. The last envelope condition assessment is from 2023, and no verification has been carried out since. The condition cannot be confirmed either way.
issues.consequence: Undiagnosed envelope water ingress progresses behind the cladding. Remediation cost rises with delay, and the assessment obligation date is missed.
issues.uncertainty: Condition is Unknown pending assessment. The repair exposure is an order-of-magnitude estimate only and should not be treated as a quote.

issues.title: Elevator maintenance evidence conflicts
issues.oneLineReason: The service log and the contractor invoice show different completion dates.
issues.whyItMatters: Two sources disagree about when the last elevator service was completed. Until that is reconciled, the maintenance record cannot be relied on.
issues.consequence: Service interval may be longer than recorded.

issues.title: Fire Alarm Test
issues.oneLineReason: Annual test due under BC Fire Code.
issues.whyItMatters: The annual fire alarm verification is due on Oct 10, 2026. The 2025 certificate is on file and current, so this is a scheduled obligation rather than a gap.
issues.consequence: A missed verification puts the building out of compliance with the BC Fire Code and may affect insurance.
issues.uncertainty: None material. The obligation date and prior certificate are both confirmed.

issues.title: Garage Drainage
issues.whyItMatters: Routine drainage clearing for the parkade is scheduled for Oct 5, 2026. The last service was completed on schedule.
issues.consequence: Deferred clearing raises the risk of standing water in the parkade during heavy autumn rainfall.

issues.title: Backflow Test
issues.whyItMatters: The annual backflow prevention device test is due Sep 30, 2026. The 2025 certificate is on file and was filed with the water purveyor.
issues.consequence: An untested device can result in a compliance notice from the water purveyor.

issues.title: Irrigation Audit
issues.whyItMatters: Seasonal shutdown and audit of the irrigation system is due before first frost. No record of last season's shutdown has been located.
issues.consequence: An un-drained system risks freeze damage to backflow devices and lines over winter.
issues.uncertainty: Last season's shutdown record is missing, so current state is not confirmed.

documents.name: Building_Envelope_Condition_Assessment_2023.pdf
documents.previewExcerpt:
5.3  NORTH ELEVATION

Sealant joints at the north elevation show early-stage adhesive failure at isolated locations. Staining observed below slab edges at levels 8 through 14 is consistent with water tracking, though no invasive review was undertaken as part of this scope.

Recommendation: monitor and reassess within 24 months. A targeted invasive review is advised should staining progress.

actions.title: Commission Building Envelope Assessment
actions.rationale: Establish actual condition before the obligation date so the repair decision rests on evidence rather than an estimate.
actions.riskOfDeferral: The assessment obligation date is missed and the $85K–$140K exposure estimate stays unverified.
